newsitem.title: DENMARK: Moellers's Svendborg up on 96 accounts.
newsitem.headline: Moellers's Svendborg up on 96 accounts.

text.p: Danish shipping giant A.P.Moellers's D/S Svendborg share climbed three percent in early Friday trade after the group on Thursday afternoon reported buoyant 1996 profits.
At 0750 GMT the share was up 8,500 crowns from Thursday's close, to 286,000 crowns per share.

Dealers said that not only was the group's 2.2 billion crown net profit good in itself but the report was more detailed than has been Moeller's custom and could therefore encourage formerly wary foreign investors. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
